author: Deremilius
name: Deremilius
text:
The global economy depends on Jensen Huang p*nis. What he did is unforgivable - The Daily Show's Nvidia spy-scandal

Desi Lydic: For more on Jensen Huang and the fallout from his affair, we go to Nvidia headquarters with senior tech correspondent Josh Johnson. Josh, what's the latest?

Josh Johnson: Desi, it's bad. Every hour is bringing new worries that Jensen Huang not only compromised America's technological edge over China, but he may have even endangered our national security.

Desi Lydic: Yeah, it's very serious. What repercussions do you think Jensen will face?

Josh Johnson: Oh, nah, we just gonna let it ride.

Desi Lydic: But you just said he put all of us at risk.
Josh Johnson: Oh yeah, 100%. What he did is unforgivable, and we all forgive him.

Desi Lydic: Why? No, no, there have to be consequences.

Josh Johnson: Desi, let me break it down for you right now. All right, the entire global economy depends on the AI bubble, and that AI bubble depends on Nvidia's chips, and Nvidia depends on Jensen Huang, and Jensen Huang depends on his penis. So to recap, the global economy depends on this penis.

Desi Lydic: Wait, so just because our economy is a bit AI-heavy, we let him just end the affair and go right back to work at Nvidia?

Josh Johnson: Oh no, no, no, no. I didn't say he has to end the affair, all right? Whatever he needs to keep those little chips coming out is what he needs, all right? He can f*** Chinese spies, Russian spies, North Korean spies. We just need to keep this man hard and happy so the dollar is stable.

Desi Lydic: But Josh, it's not just about the economy. What if China takes the lead on AI? They would dominate the world.

Josh Johnson: Oh, no! Then our lives would be at the mercy of a different small group of old rich men who sleep with Chinese women. All right?

Desi Lydic: Look, maybe I'm naive, but there needs to be some kind of accountability for these CEOs. No one wants economic hardship, I get that. But morally, they have to be held to some code of ethics. Plus, he should have known that she was a spy. I mean, that jacket was pathetic. Sorry, Josh, are you wearing a leather jacket?

Josh Johnson: Yes, I am. And I disagree, Desi. I think this is what cool guys wear. Just putting it on makes me feel like my penis controls the Nasdaq.

Desi Lydic: Everyone loves a man who looks like he does tech support for the Sons of Anarchy.

Josh Johnson: Oh, wait, what's that? Huh. A FaceTime call from China. It's working already.

Desi Lydic: Oh, no, no, no, Josh, don't answer that! Josh Johnson, everybody!
